run: Synthetic 96/384 and DirectWrite 96 leaves; 20 iterations per batch, 9 alternating batches per profile; timing and C++ allocation executables run sequentially
note: Executable hashes identify the measured binaries. The source snapshot is the commit containing this record. Size-only, baseline, and full fragments use distinct cache keys. The allocation probe intercepts C++ new/delete only; DirectWrite/COM internal allocations are outside its count. Peak live bytes are summarized by the median of batch means and each batch is retained in raw CSV.
